title: Auth
summary: Privy social login → session → logout → gated pages → auth sync. Design F/V/S cases from each leaf.

nodes.label: Auth
nodes.summary: Privy social OAuth into an embedded wallet session.
nodes.detail: Terms emphasize Google/X; Apple also shown in the login modal [Observed].

nodes.label: Login modal
nodes.summary: LOG IN / SIGN UP opens Privy modal with social providers.

nodes.label: Google
nodes.summary: Sign in with Google — session persists on reload; wallet address shown.
tcIdeas: Happy: Google OAuth completes → authed chrome
Alt: cancel mid-Google flow returns to app without session

nodes.label: X (Twitter)
nodes.summary: Sign in with X — same session expectations as Google.

nodes.label: Apple
nodes.summary: Apple visible in modal; same if offered [Observed].

nodes.label: Cancel / close modal
nodes.summary: Closing the modal without OAuth leaves the user unauthenticated.
tcIdeas: Close/X/backdrop → no session; gated pages still gated

nodes.label: Deny OAuth
nodes.summary: User denies provider consent — recoverable; no partial auth.
tcIdeas: Deny at IdP → clear error or return to login; no half-session

nodes.label: Session persist
nodes.summary: Authenticated shell survives reload; LOG OUT / SET USERNAME chrome [Observed].

nodes.label: Session expiry
nodes.summary: Expired / revoked refresh → re-auth; gated surfaces reappear.
nodes.detail: Logout can revoke Privy refresh tokens server-side [Observed in TC run].

nodes.label: Logout
nodes.summary: LOG OUT clears session; gated pages require sign-in again.

nodes.label: Gated pages
nodes.summary: Garage, Mileage, and funded flows require auth.

nodes.label: Auth sync
nodes.summary: /api/auth/sync healthy or clear failure vs Privy session.
tcIdeas: Authed session: sync succeeds or surfaces recoverable error

nodes.label: Eligibility attestation
nodes.summary: 18+ and Stock Token rules before first claim/swap (Buy $GAS path Observed).

nodes.label: No seed in support UX
nodes.summary: Side menu / settings must not request wallet seed for support.
tcIdeas: Settings/support copy never asks for seed/password/unlock fee
